items.title: Nvidia and Palantir Team Up on AI Supply Chain Tech—Why the Stock Market Isn’t Biting
items.summary: Nvidia  and  Palantir  Technologies are the dream team of artificial intelligence, bringing together hardware and software.  The two companies said Thursday they were combining their capabilities to create AI to improve supply chains but it wasn’t doing much for the shares.  “Organizations across complex industries — including agriculture, manufacturing, pharmaceutical, retail, technology and governments — can use the AI stack to optimize their own unique supply chain operations,” the companies said in a statement.

items.title: Rackspace Shares Rise 13% After Joining NVIDIA Cloud Partner Program
items.summary: Rackspace Technology (NASDAQ:RXT) shares rose 13% on Thursday morning after the company said it joined the NVIDIA Cloud Partner Program and plans to offer NVIDIA Blackwell-powered artificial intelligence infrastructure for regulated enterprises and governments. Under the collaboration, Rackspace will combine NVIDIA accelerated computing with Palantir software and governed private-cloud infrastructure.

items.title: Palantir and Fujitsu Renew AI Partnership and Expand Forward Deployed Engineering Role
items.summary: Palantir Technologies (NASDAQ:PLTR) and Fujitsu Limited renewed their strategic partnership, with Fujitsu entering a new agreement covering Palantir AIP and Palantir Foundry and becoming a Global Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) Partner. The partnership, which began in 2020, will expand Fujitsu’s investment in deployed engineering capabilities for enterprise customers in Japan and international markets.
